expectations.text: Evaluates the codebase architecture BEFORE proposing a structure
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Before touching any files, map what you have into coherent groups' and does a cluster analysis table

expectations.text: Does NOT prescribe a generic layered architecture with model/service/transport as primary grouping
expectations.evidence: No model/service/io layering. Proposes domain clusters: types/, registry/, image/, cache/, ops/, cli/

expectations.text: Proposes grouping by domain responsibility or pipeline phase
expectations.evidence: Groups by domain: types/, registry/, image/, cache/, ops/, cli/ with clear rationale

expectations.text: Identifies that types like digest, platform, layer belong with their domain, not a catch-all types/ or model/
expectations.evidence: FAILS: Creates a types/ directory containing manifest.rs, digest.rs, platform.rs, layer.rs — the 'model bag' anti-pattern. Explicitly argues 'Putting it under any one of those creates import noise everywhere else'

expectations.text: Mentions keeping lib.rs skeletal with fewer top-level declarations
expectations.evidence: Shows lib.rs with 8 pub mod declarations. Says 'Stop declaring 16 pub mod entries in lib.rs'
